title: Quietly Yeasty Algerian Turnip Tagine
description: A yeasty and velvety Algerian dish featuring turnips and nuka-pickle, perfect for a family dinner. This kid-friendly recipe is also Buddhist-temple-friendly and can be served from a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cubed turnips, chopped nuka-pickle, cumin, and paprika, and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, proof the yeast by mixing it with 1 tablespoon of warm water.
Add the yeast mixture to the Dutch oven and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot from a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
